Subject: New vendor — Delivero onboarding request / DPA + PO info

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this — Delivero (procurement@delivero.com) is preparing to go live with Redwood for our delivery routing features. Procurement asked that we surface the legal/security artifacts and confirm the PO process so we can create the PO on our side. Can you confirm the following?

- Do you have an executed DPA we can countersign?
- Link to the latest SOC 2 Type II report we can share with our security team
- Current subprocessor roster (we need to check any cross-border subprocessors)
- Redwood PO creation flow and invoice routing + sample PO template

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboard_delivero.pdf) and can provide tax/W9 info after I know the PO flow.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we are targeting next Wednesday for activation.

Best,
Samir Khan
Head of Procurement Operations
Delivero Inc.
attachments: vendor_onboard_delivero.pdf

Subject: Re: New vendor — Delivero onboarding request / DPA + PO info

Hi Samir — great to meet you. Welcome!

Quick summary and next steps from Redwood:

1) DPA: attaching our standard DPA for signature (Delivero_DPA_Draft_20270518.pdf). We can route via DocuSign; here's the envelope link: https://app.docusign.com/Envelope/XYZ-Delivero-20270518. Please sign and we'll countersign within 24 hours once received.

2) SOC 2: our latest Type II report is here (restricted link for security review): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/2026-typeii-report.pdf. If you need us to share an NDA'ed copy or provide a security slide deck, let me know.

3) Subprocessors: attached list (Delivero_Subprocessors_20270518.xlsx). Highlights: analytics provider (US), CDN (multi-region), and a managed logging provider (US/EU). Call out anything that looks sensitive and we'll follow up.

4) PO + Invoicing: we do accept PO numbers. Please follow the attached PO_Instructions_Redwood.pdf. Short version:
- Send PO to billing@redwood.com with Delivero as the account name and expected start date.
- Invoices go to ap@delivero.com (we will support either PDF invoices emailed or invoices via our vendor portal).
- Typical processing time for PO issuance on your side is 3–5 business days.

Action items for Delivero:
- Sign the DPA via DocuSign link above
- Confirm billing contact and remit-to (invoice) details (we'll need bill-to + tax ID)
- If you want an initial PO number from your side, send it to marissa.cole@redwood.com and cc neha.kapoor@redwood.com

CC'd Marissa (Sales Ops) and Neha (Finance) to coordinate PO and billing setup.

Thanks — I can hop on a 15-min call if you prefer to run through this.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Vanessa — that's perfect. I routed the DPA internally and signed via DocuSign (you should see the envelope come through). I attached the executed DPA for your records (Delivero_Executed_DPA_20270518.pdf).

Billing contact for Delivero: 
- Accounts Payable: ap@delivero.com
- Remit-to / Tax ID: Delivero Inc., TIN 12-3456789 (will attach a W9 in a follow-up email once you confirm PO flow)
- Estimated first-month spend: $6,500 (pilot) — we'll include that on the PO.

Question: does Redwood require any SLAs to be set on the PO, or do you typically handle SLAs in the Master Services Agreement? We usually prefer the SLA referenced on the PO so our legal team can cross-check.

On the subprocessors list — I flagged the logging provider. If there are any EU-hosted processing pathways needed, we'll highlight that in our security review.

Best,
Samir Khan
Head of Procurement Operations, Delivero

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the executed DPA. Confirming next steps from Sales Ops / Finance: 

- We received the signed DPA and will countersign by EOD tomorrow.
- Please send PO to billing@redwood.com with this format:
  - PO number in subject line
  - Billing contact: ap@delivero.com
  - Line items: Product SKU, Qty, Monthly committed tokens (if applicable), Start date

- Invoices: Send PDF invoices to invoices@redwood.com and cc ap@delivero.com. If you prefer ACH/wire, include remittance instructions on the first invoice and our AR team will send wiring details.

Regarding SLAs: we typically keep availability SLAs in the Master Services Agreement and reference the MSA on the PO. If you need the SLA language surfaced on the PO itself, we can add a short clause — I can draft that and loop legal if you confirm.

I'll create the internal vendor record today and share the Redwood vendor ID and next steps in this thread once it's live. Welcome aboard!

—Marissa Cole
